tools.name: birth_chart
tools.description: Compute a birth chart from a date, time and place. Returns a block of text containing natal placements, Human Design type and centres, chart patterns and a written entry for the birthday. The block carries its own instructions: interpret it, do not summarise it.

tools.name: day_entry
tools.description: The written entry for one birthday, with its tags: sun sign, element, modality, decan, decan ruler, season and numerology. Describes a date, not a person.
